concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑002 (model explanatory power measured by R‑squared) is not referenced by any task in the implementation plan. No task records or validates R‑squared against a threshold or reports it as evidence.

Success Criterion SC‑003 (robustness consistency between full sample and high‑engagement subset) is absent from the plan. While FR‑006 and the robustness check task exist, the plan never ties the robustness result to a pass/fail SC‑003 evaluation.

Success Criterion SC‑004 (validity of inference measured by assumption‑check results) is not linked to any plan element. Assumption checks are performed (FR‑007), but the plan does not record a pass/fail decision that satisfies SC‑004.
